name: TriviumDB Smart Recall
author: DJLegends
description: Find any moment from your chats and lorebooks by what it meant, not the exact words, and let the AI remember relevant older moments of a long chat. Runs on TriviumDB 0.9.0 (vector + BM25 + graph engine), which other extensions can use too through window.__SIGMA_TRIVIUM__.db and the triviumdb.* commands.
